_comment: Mutation testing on the pure engine (D-26, D-68): weekly CI in shards (ADR 0239, ADR 0249; `pnpm mutation:shard`), locally `pnpm mutation`, incremental (ADR 0151): only mutants in changed code or tests rerun; `pnpm mutation --force` reruns all. thresholds.break = DR-168 baseline 98.70 % floored (2026-10-05); raise it, never lower it. Survivors: DR-168. ignorePatterns keep the files tests read at load (docs/csv-import.md, src-tauri/tauri.conf.json, src-tauri/src; #443). `pnpm mutation` runs in Europe/Prague time: a test that sets process.env.TZ at run time does not change the zone under Stryker's runner (#443). dryRunTimeoutMinutes: the initial run of the whole suite takes ~3 min locally and over the 5 min default on a CI runner (#443).
